svg.text: The budget is met by moving less
WHY THE FUSIONS ARE EXACT, not merely convenient: window -- F{w.s}, a pointwise scale commutes with the read;
azimuth gather -- the feeder already chooses which sample to present; detect -- |z| is pointwise on the FFT output;
corner-turn #2 -- strip-pipelined against FFT-2, legal because the 1-D transforms of distinct rows are INDEPENDENT.
